title: Turkish-Style Lahmacun with Crispy Bacon
description: A twist on the classic Turkish lahmacun, topped with crispy bacon and a sprinkle of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: lahmacun
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the lahmacun into 6 equal pieces.
Place the lahmacun pieces on the prepared baking sheet.
Top each piece with a slice of crispy bacon.
Sprinkle the aromatic spice blend and turkish red pepper flakes over the bacon.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the bacon is crispy and the lahmacun is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
